The army followed his example and entered quietly and peaceably, no house was robbed, no woman insulted. One thing alone met destruction. Going to the Kaabah, Mohammad stood before each of the three hundred and sixty idols and pointed to it with his staff, saying : "Truth is come and falsehood has fled away", and at these (Quranic) words all the idols and household gods of Macca and round about miraculously destroyed themselves."It was thus that Mohammad entered again his native city. Through all the annals of conquest there is no triumphant entry like unto this one" (Mohammad, Prophet and Statesman by W. Montgomery Watt).This incident brings out the meaning of Jihad as taught by Mohammad that one's life has to be completely in surrender to the wishes of the Creator. This is supported by :"Say: Lo ! my worship and my sacrifice and my living and my dying are all for Allah the Lord of the Universe" [109].It was such unique and unparalled examples of his Jihad or self-control which has won for him the admiration of foreign research scholars all over the world. Only one of them is quoted here :"Philosopher, Orator, apostle, legislator, warrior, conqueror of ideas, restorer of rational dogmas, a cult without images ; the founder of twenty terrestrial empires and of one spiritual empire. That is Mohammad ! As regards all standards by which human greatness may be measured, we may well ask, is there any man greater than he ?" [110].For more such references please refer to pages 465—477 of "Destruction or Peace".P. SOME UNIQUE MIRACLES OF THE COMFORTER-SAVIOURMiracles have been performed from time to time by numerous Prophets and Saints in the past. The number of miracles performed by the Comforter Saviour of the Universe are far too many and would require many dozens of thick volumes just to list them. A few of the unique ones which nobody has performed are included here :1. The Miracles relating to inanimate objects :Inanimate objects like rocks, hills, trees etc. used to revere and obey the Holy Prophet Mohammad. No other Prophet in the world received such honour [111].a) One day Abu Jahal came with a crowd of Pagan supporters to Mohammad with a magic Brass Idol and asked the idol to abuse the Holy Prophet. The idol instead of abusing the Prophet recitedthe Kalma :-"There is none worthy of divine worship except Allah and Mohammad is the messenger sent by Allah" [112].b) Once an uneducated tribal Bedouin came to the Holy Prophet and said – if you can get that particular old large tree to come over here and give evidence that Allah is only one and that you are His Prophet, I shall become a Muslim. Accordingly at the request of Mohammad the tree drew out its roots from under the ground and came crawling on its roots, recited the Kalma in Arabic "That none is worthy of divine worship save Allah and Mohammad is the messenger sent by Allah", thereafter it went back to its original position [113].c) In the Mosque of the Prophet at Madinah, there was the dead stump of a tree against which the Holy Prophet Mohammad leaned when making speeches. When the mosque was extended, a new pulpit was built. The day the Holy Prophet went to make his first speech from this pulpit, the stump started weeping so loudly that all the people in the mosque heard it. Mohammad went and consoled the stump by saying : "Do you want to be with me on this earth or in Heaven ? “ The log replied it preferred the hereafter ! So it was buried at that very spot [114].2. Miracles relating to objects outside the Earth : Only one such example is being mentioned here out of several.It was the full-moon night of the 14th of the Lunar month of Rajjab, in the eighth year after prophethood and five years before Hijrah i.e. corresponding to 617 A.D. that a group of pagans alongwith a group of Jews came to Mohammad and challenged him, that if he was the Prophet of Allah, he should prove it by splitting the moon on this full moon night.The Holy Prophet went on top of the hill Abu Kubeys at Macca accompanied by them alongwith many others. At a sign of his finger the moon was split into two. One piece moving away Northward and the other Southward, whilst continuing in their rotation around the earth.All caravans arriving at Macca for several weeks thereafter confirmed that they saw the moon split into two at this particular time and date, even though they were as far away as Syria and Palestine etc. They also confirmed that all the local people of the numerous towns in these countries had also seen it with great amazement ! [115]Raja Bhoj, King of Dhar—a town near the Chambal River in Malwa Plateau in Central India, was enjoying a quiet midnight in his palace garden, when he saw the moon split into two halves which moved away from each other. Frightened at this sight, he raised an alarm thinking the destruction of the world was at hand. Hundreds of thousands of people of Western India witnessed this disturbing sight. The pundits pointed out from "Bhavishya Puran" that it had been foretold that a great personage would be born in Arabia. He would not be taught how to read or write yet he would teach the world what they knew not.His teaching would be logical, wonderful and simple. These teachings would influence the world. His name would be Mahamad. The splitting of the moon would be one of his numerous miracles. That those who would not follow the teachings of this great divine messenger would eventually be losers on this earth and in the next life. Raja Bhoj accordingly converted to Islam [116].Q. MIRACLES PERFORMED EVEN BEFORE HIS BIRTHNobody can perform any miracles before his birth. The only exception has been the Comforter Saviour of the Universe. In his case the miracles before his birth have been many. One such example is quoted herein.When Adam was created the unpolluted earth was a veritable paradise—The beautiful "Garden of Eden". Unfortunately the first Civilisation of man upon acquiring Nuclear and Scientific knowledge from the two angels fought several major Nuclear wars against the two major colonisations of men, viz. the Eastern comprising of Egypt, Mediterranean and Mesopotamia and the other, in Central America, Peru and Brazil areas. Thus vast areas of the earth were polluted. Eventually Mankind became so wicked that they completely violated the sanctity of sex and considered marriage as something outdated. Men and women freely indulged in sexual abuses which gave pleasures. Thus they prided upon their broadmindedness and freedom. The show of their parties were the beautiful dancers both male and females. In the course of dancing they would not only display their nakedness but they would also induce the honoured guests of the opposite sex to enjoy them, as they were experts at giving sexual enjoyment of every description. These led to rape, violence, insecurity, jealousies, rivalries, bloodshed and murders.This situation demanded punishment from the Almighty. The Holy Bible has described it as:"And God saw that the wickedeness of men was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually."And the Lord said : I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth ; both man and beast and the creeping things, and fowls of the air............"But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord" [117].Noah (Peace of God be on him) warned these scientifically advanced people to give up their sinful ways of freedom of sex, violence, murders, rape and disobedience of God's orders otherwise the Lord would drown them. In reply they boasted that the Almighty could not harm them by His threat of drowning as this planet was much too large with many high mountains and plateaus to be completely flooded in any one single castastrophe. Further they were ready all over the world to shoot off with most of the people then living on Earth in their Nuclear Rockets which were much more powerful than any storm that the God of Noah could bring about. As such they were more than fully confident of saving themselves. So they had no reasons whatsoever to be afraid of the Creator and His threats !They laughed at and mocked Noah for building a wooden Ark and that also without any machineries in it to escape the deluge. It was really beyond their comprehension how a powerless craft made of wood, a very weak material, would escape the deluge when their nuclear powered space rockets made out of scientifically developed metals which were many times more powerful, stronger and safer were not going to escape according to the warnings of Noah.So when Noah entered the Ark a radio warning was flashed all over the earth to stand by expecting the Almighty's curse. What these scientists could not anticipate, inspite of all their alertness, was that at that very moment Allah caused a big outburst in Jupiter which threw out a large white hot mass which hurtled past just missing the Earth !It caused the Earth's atmosphere to be charged with electric energy which electrocuted all those near their Nuclear Rockets or any kind of metals or machinery. The gases from the tail of this mass burnt up a part of the Oxygen in earth's atmosphere which glowed red hot. This created a heat wave which melted the snows all over the earth including the two polar ice-caps, the icebergs, glaciers and the snows on Mountain peaks. It also rained down a liquid like thick crude oil. The gravitation pull of this huge mass from so near a distance titled the earth's axis. It upset the equilibrium of the Earth and threw out from the bowels of this planet literally many seas of hot burning lavae. Thus causing huge vacuums under the crust all over the world. This resulted in many parts of the earth's surface to be sucked in and collapse. Many Islands like Atlantis sank. The level of the ocean bed rose upward [118].According to Cesari Emiliani of University of Miami the North American ice-cap underwent a sudden collapse followed by rapid melting. Emiliani says : "A huge amount of ice-melted water rushed into the Gulf of Mexico and produced a Sea-level rise, that spread around the world with the speed of a great tidal wave which can circle the earth in 24 hours” [119]. Emiliani's findings are corrobrated by geologist James Kennet of the University of Rhodes Island and Nicholas Shackton of Cambridge University. The burning liquids from under-ground, the melting snows, the forty days and nights of continuous down pour of heavy rains and the floods from the Oceans submerged everything including all the montains according to the Holy Scriptures [120]. A vivid example being Mount Illimani, 6457 metres above sea-level and its adjoining depression in the Andes Mountain along the Peru Bolivian border. This depression is at a height of 3810 metres above sea-level. It is 222 Kms long and 111 Kms. wide. It has a depth of 244 metres. The evidence of maritime life at this fantastic height and the ruins of Tiahuanaso found six feet below the present level of Lake Titicaca goes to show to what incredible heights the sea waters of Noah's flood rose ! (The Article "Lake on Top of the World" by James Winchester on pages 82—88 of Reader's Digest of May 1947).Do the findings and research of scientists support the fantastic world-wide calamities of the great deluge? Here area few quotations from different experts out of hundreds that could be quoted !"In Western North America, the Columbia River basalts compriss more than 60,000 cubic miles of piled up lava-sheets spread over a region considerably more than 100,000 square miles " [121]."We have gained from the mulch pits of the Yukon Valley a picture of "Quick extinction". The evidences there are as obvious as in the horror camps of (Hitler's Nazi) Germany. Such piles of bodies of animals and men simply do not occur by only ordinary means" [122].“We live in a Zoologically impoverished world, from which all the hugest and fiercest and strangest froms have recently disappeared.............. yet it is surely a marvellous fact, and onethat has hardly been sufficiently dwelt upon, this sudden dying out of so many large Mammalia, not in one place only but over half the surface of the globe (according to findings and discoveries made uptil 1962 A. D., since then the excavations show that this sudden disaster covers the whole face of the earth)" [123].Noah took only representatives of various mammal groups— but certainly not every variety. This now clearly explains why so many mammals became extinct. We have, for example, certain species of elephants with us today but not all the different species. The woolly mammoth and mastodon, relatives of the modern elephant, died in the deluge never to be replaced again, as there is no such thing as evolution otherwise they would certainly have evolved from the ordinary elephants.Scientific findings show that some terrible cataclysms such as the Deluge, the snow-age, sudden convulsions and upheavals of the earth's surface, or sudden alterations of conditions and other disasters have on numerous occassions in the past wiped out totally the reptiles, the mammals and several other forms of life on earth.As a result there is not a single living thing on the face of this earth, which is 50,000 years old, or even twenty-five thousand or even ten thousand years old.The oldest living things on the face of the earth are trees. Speaking about the "Bristlecone Pine'', the famous scientist Edmund Schulman said :"Microscopic study of growth rings reveals that a bristlecone pine tree found last summer at nearly 10,000 feet began growing more than 4,300 years ago. Many of its neighbours are nearlyas old; we have now dated 17 bristlecone pines 4,000 years old or more" [124].Dr. Schulman was very much puzzled with the same approximate age limit of about 4,000 years of the Giant Sequoia, trees which he had studied. These trees enjoy near-perpetual life in the absence of gross destruction, they even appear to be immune to insect attacks. Because this is so Dr. Schulman asked the following question as early as 1934 :"Pertinent also is the well-known fact that standing snags of this species, other than those resulting from factors of gross destructions, are unknown. Does this mean that shortly preceeding 3273 years (or 4000 years ago if John Muir's somewhat doubtful count was correct) all the then living giant Sequoias were wiped out by some Catastrophe" [125].That is something to think about : Why is it that these various varieties of still-living trees are each about 4,000 years old ? Further they seem to be the original trees that grew in their present stands ! One is tempted to ask the question : Did any terrible catastrophe occur which wiped out completely not only the entire animals and plants but even human lives just beyond the historical era i. e. around 4,000 / 4,300 years ago ? Had something happened in the recent past to wipe out the old system of things then in existence and bring into being a new system ? If it were so, then it explains everything logically and scientifically.The Holy Bible, Tafrihul Azkia Fil Ahwal Ul Anbia, Taskiratal Anbia, the Quran and other religious scriptures tell us that about 2370 B. C. or 4355 years ago from today 1985 A. D. a great Deluge drowned and destroyed all living forms of life on this planet including the entire human race except for those eight persons in Noah's Ark. This flood not only brought thick layers of clay, and mud and maritime life from the sea beds and elsewhere over the tops of Mountains but at the same time lava flowed out of the bowels of the earth not as a stream as is now being experienced but as a veritable fiery flood. It filled the valleys, burnt up the forests, streamed out lakes and buried mountains and covered the earth with a new virgin layer of soil by effacing all signs of previous forms of life and vegetation, thereby giving a new start to many forms of animal and vegetable life on this earth. Even people living in isolation in South America have legends of this flood. The Hopi Indians living far from the sea and the Incas living high in the Peruvian Andes have legends of a great flood washing over the land covering the tops of the mountains and effacing virtually all life on earth. The cuneiform tablets dug up in Mesopotamia also speak of this terrible flood. Learned Researchers have commented :"A deluge such as that described in the Book of Genesis occurs in the legends and folklore of almost every ancient people."Such agreement among the legends of so many peoples living in distant parts of the world has caused scholars in modern times to wonder whether mankind in truth experienced the worldwide catastrophe of a deluge" [126].Nothing escaped not even men, animals and plants on the face of the earth This planet become uninhabitable for a period of 204 days in 2370 B C. according to Biblical calculations [120].The white hot mass which caused this catastrophe and nearly destroyed the earth upon being attracted by the gravity of the Sun became its youngest planet known as Venus. It is still an inferno after 4355 years. Ridiculously it rotates backward on its axis. It takes 243 days to make one rotation on its axis. Venus takes 224.7 days to make a circumference around the Sun. Thus God has proved that He is much more powerful than Man and all his intelligence and science put together.Just because the saviour of the Universe was going to be born in 570 A.D. from a descendant of Noah so Allah saved that helpless unpowered Ark and all that were therein which floated safely over the boiling liquid mass insulated by thick wood against both heat and electricity in the atmosphere. The Crude oil from above acted as a further preservative !R. THE SECOND CIVILISATION OF MANWhen Noah's Ark landed upon Mount Ararat after the floods subsided there were left only Noah, his wife, his three sons and their three wives. A total of only eight human beings. Noah was over 600 years of age of that time. So he had no more children. Noah lived for 350 years after the deluge.The second civilisation of man has come from the three surviving sons of Noah who were blessed with plenty of children after the floods :1) Shem was the eldest son of Noah. He had a fair-coloured skin. From him has come about the basic race known scientifically as Caucasoid with colour of eyes, hair and skin light. The hair structure is fine to medium, wavy or straight. Beard and body hair is usually abundant. Nose is high and narrow. The blood group tends more towards "A" than "B". They are spread over Northern India, Iran, Middle East, Arabia, North Africa, Europe and in the European Colonies of America and Australia etc.A group was separated in the very early stages, perhaps immediately after the curse upon the Tower of Babel. This group is commonly known as the Archiac Whites of Australia.2) Japheth is the second son of Noah. He is the father of the Mongoloid race. His basic characteristics are :Hair is black.Skin is yellow.Eyes are brown.Eye forms are slanting but not much recessed with the Mongoloid eyefold.Hair texture is coarse with very little beard and body hair.Noses are moderately broad with a low bridge.Their blood group is usually high in "B".They are found all over Asia and the Arctic regions, excluding South West Asia, Persia, South East Asia and most parts of India.The American Indians belong to this category of the human race. They separated from the main group shortly after the Tower of Babel incident.3) Ham is the third son of Noah. He had a dark-brownish to back skin with woolly hair. From him have developed the dark-skinned races of the world. He is the originator of the Negroids (Africa excluding the North), Dravidians and South Indians and Hamites of Abyssinia, Eritrea and South Arabia.Noah had a fourth son. He did not believe in God. He refused to go with his father into the Ark. Rather he made fun of Noah and his God. When the waters of the Deluge came he confidently climbed up the highest mountain in the area to save himself. The flood waters rose above the top of the highest mountain. So this wicked son of Noah was drowned with the rest of the people on earth !The three basic types of mankind now in existence all over the world can trace their origin directly from one or more of the three sons of Noah who were saved. Hence the second civilisation of man are the children of Noah, who was himself a descendant of Adam.In the beginning they all spoke one common language, and lived as one large joint family This unity of Mankind continued until the curse of God at the Tower of Babel. They all went to sleep speaking one language. They arose the next morning speaking different languages causing confusion, disunity and seperation This is the origin of the different races, tribes and nationalities amongst mankind !God promised to Noah that He would never again destroy the whole of mankind by water [127]. This time the warning is that this second civilisation of man when they become equally advanced in science and evil they will destroy themselves by fire—a clear indication towards a Nuclear Holocaust or Armageddon !Now arises the question, how can we save ourselves from Armageddon ? chapters.heading: Chapter 9 : The Loving Being Of Light—The Comforter Of The Universe
paragraphs: Man finds himself better off from worldly standards as far as wealth, position and influence are concerned as compared to those who claim themselves to be the Prophets of God. Naturally they contend that if there is a God, then that God is certainly giving them much more luxuries, comfort, wealth, honour, respect and position as compared to those who claim to be Prophets. On that basis they contend that they are more blessed by God on this earth in comparision to those who are Prophets. Because such is generally the case. As such they claim that by worldly standards those who are more blessed on earth than the Prophets have no necessity of such Prophets and their teachings.Further Prophets are persons who want man to observe strict laws of goodness and piety. They feel these are very difficult for ordinary persons to live upto. As such Man considers Prophets as asking for impossible conditions to be fulfilled. So they must be off their heads or demented. Hence according to the proud and the rich, the Prophets are unsuitable for the guidance of the masses.Man ordinarily cannot communicate with God. Yet he considers himself more knowledgeable. If he cannot communicate with God then he naturally contends that Prophets also cannot communicate with God. So in his pride and arrogance Man from time immemorial has challenged that Prophets are nothing but "Bashr" i.e. mere common persons at best like themselves.A. MERE MORTALS (BASHR) LIKE US—BELIEF OF DISBELIEVERSHere are a few quotations from the Quran recording the disbelievers' contentions :"And set out for them a parable: The people of a city, when the messengers (of God) came unto them"When We (Allah) sent to them two, they rejected both of them. Then We strengthened (them) with a third, so they said : Surely we are messengers sent to you."They taunted : You are naught but mere mortals (Bashr) like ourselves. The Beneficent (Creator) has not revealed any thing (unto you) ! You only lie" [128]."They contend: O thou unto whom the Divine message is given to remind (people of the right path of Guidance), lo ! thou art indeed a madman" [129].B. PUNISHMENT TO DISBELIEVERS WHO MOCKED PROPHETS THAT YOU ARE MERE MORTALS LIKE US" ...Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him (by saying that you are nothing but a common mortal like us i.e. one who does not receive any Divine Guidance)."Have they not seen how many generations We (Allah) have destroyed before them (which like the Scientifically advanced people of Atlantis, the pre-deluge civilisation of the time of Noah, Babylon, Assyria, Ninevah, Pompeii, the tribes of Thamud and Shuaib etc.) who never revived ?"But (remember well) without exception all will be brought (out of their graves on the Day of Judgement) before Us (Allah)” [130]."Has not the story reached you of those, who disbelieved of old (who used to mock their prophets by saying you are mortals like us and do not possess any guidance from God, rather you are mad and demented to think that we should follow such strict laws as you want us to observe) ? And so did taste of the calamities (and destruction that befell upon them) due to their conduct, and theirs will be a painful doom (in the hereafter also)."That was because their messengers kept coming unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's sovereignty), but they mocked : Shall mere mortals guide us ? So they disbelieved and turned away. And Allah is Independent. Allah is Absolute, The Owner of all Praise" [131].C. SOME FAMOUS CALAMITIES UPON THOSE WHO MOCKED PROPHETSA few examples of famous disasters that befell mankind because they mocked their prophets as mere mortals are :Noah : The Predeluge people destroyed by the Great Deluge [132].Abraham : King Nimrod cast Abraham into a great fire. Eventually Nimrod and his mighty army met death by violence for disbelief in Abraham [133].Lot : The people of Sodom and Gomorrah who were destroyed in the Dead Sea Disaster [134].Moses : Pharaoh with the entire Egyptian Army was drowned when crossing along the sea bed of the Red Sea [135].D. IS THE LOVING BEING OF LIGHT A HUMAN BEING ACCORDING TO QURAN ?We human beings have been created out of "Dust" or "Clay" [136]. The Holy Prophet Mohammad has been made out of "Allah's Nur" or "Allah's Light" [137]. It will therefore be evident that he is from a totally different element as compared to us. So there can be no comparison between him and us."Had We (Allah) appointed an angel (i.e. one made out of 'Nur' as the Angels are or as Prophet Mohammad is is made of the 'Nur' or 'Light' of Allah We (Allah) assuredly (would) have made him (to appear before mankind as) a (common) mortal and (Allah has thus) hidden from them i.e. Mankind (the truth of who or what His Messenger Mohammad in reality is). This is a matter in which they (Mankind) have already been covered with ignorance" [138]."Say (unto them O Mohammad ! by My Order) : Verily, am I (who is made out of the 'Nur' or 'Light' of Allah) a (common) mortal like you (who is made out of clay) ? It is inspired (by Allah) in me (the book of guidance i.e. the Quran and through it) that your Lord is only a single God (have you been similarly inspired with a Book of Guidance from the Alimighty ?) and I seek (continuously) forgiveness (for my followers) from Him (from the time of my birth when I miraculously spoke and said : "Rabbi Habli Ummati" i.e. O Sustainer of the Universe forgive those who follow me [139]. And which I continued praying for my followers until my departure from earthly life. Have you also miraculously spoken thus upon your birth asking for forgiveness of your followers and do you also pray continuously for the forgiveness of all your followers as I did even until and upon my death bed ?—Nay) and (so) woe unto polytheists (i.e. those who in their pride upon their wordly knowledge and power think and imagine themselves to be like mortals or equals of Mohammad and Allah causes such to be covered in ignorance as warned in the above quotation of the Quran)" [140].E. HOW THE LOVING BEING OF LIGHT IS TO BE HONOUREDBecause the Holy Prophet Mohammad (Peace of Allah be on him) is far superior to any other creation so Allah has passed the following orders on Man:"And lo! those who disbelieve, would do everything in their power to shake thee (i.e. thy faith with the power of their eyes. When the latter died four years later he nominated his slave lltutmish to become his heir in 1210 A.D. After him came his daughter Queen Raziya. Upon her death she was succeeded by Nasiruddin Mahmud in 1240 A.D who was the next slave to become a king. When he died in 1266 A.D. Ghiyasuddin Balban became the last slave king of India.The World cannot show any examples of slaves being nominated heirs of their masters. chapters.heading: Chapter 10 : Nuclear Holocaust—Why ? Where? When?
paragraphs: The 14th Century of Islam ended on 9th November 1981. The 15th Century has commenced from 1st. Muharram 1401 A.H. or 10th November, 1981. How is it going to effect mankind? This becomes a very important question for all irrespective of Caste, Colour, Creed, Nationality or Religion, because ISLAM represents :
"I" Stands for I"S" Stands for SHALL"L" Stands for LOVE"A" Stands for ALL"M" Stands for MANKIND

Islam has taught for the past 1400 years "I SHALL LOVE ALL MANKIND". When the Quran has declared :"Lo ! This your brotherhood is a single brotherhood (of mankind), and I am the Sustainer Lord (of all mankind), so adore Me" [171].Islam has repeatedly foretold, that the worst stage of sins, wickedness and evil that Man can ever fall to, will be reached by the end of this 14th Century. The 15th Century will bring about a new civilisation with the finest period that Man has ever experienced. But not before terrible wars between nations which will destroy so large a section of mankind that it could be termed as "Kiamat Sogra". This means a near total destruction of the earth. Such a "Kiamat Sogra" has taken place a number of times on earth like the annihilation of the Reptilian Age and its replacement by Mammals. The last time such an incident happened was the Great Deluge which destroyed by floods the first civilisation of mankind. The second civilisation of man started from the three surviving sons of Noah. It was warned at that time that when men would again become as wicked as at the time of Noah, then the second civilisation of mankind would be brought to similar end by a worldwide holocaust of fire. This time a few pious people would survive and bring about the new or the third civilisation of Man.The Quran in Surah 39-AI Zumar: Ayat 53 informs that a stage will come on Earth when mankind on the whole will become such sinners that they will destroy themselves. This will take place some years after 1401 A.H. This figure marking the commencement of the new century is arrived at when the middle sentence of this Ayat is converted into figures viz : "La Tuqnatu mir Rahmat il-Lahae" = 1401. So it refers to the period of about 25 years estimated to bring about the change The period has already started running from 1982 A.D. It should end by about 2006 A.D. Before that date the frightening destructions on the earth by fire created by man should have taken place. This verse further announces the good news for believers viz :"Do not despair of Allah's Mercy".So some of those who believe are going to survive and enjoy the most wonderful period man has ever known. When that period comes, wars will become a thing of the past. All mankind would be bonded in to a single brotherhood, with a single language and religion. Thus making the Earth into a veritable Paradise. These joys, happiness, peace and contentment will be a reward for those who accept the guidance of the "Being of Light", who has been sent on earth as "Rahmat-al-lil-Aalamin" i.e. a Blessing or Comforting Saviour for a the Universe.The Holy Bible has also referred to the Comforter repeatedly e. g. :a) WHO IS THIS COMFORTER ?"But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost (i.e. a Holy Spirit from God), whom the Father (i.e. God) will send……..” [173]."But when the Comforter is come whom I will send unto you from the Father (God), even the Spirit of Truth which proceedeth from the Father (God), he shall testify of me" [174].b) WHAT WILL THE COMFORTER DO ?“Nevertheless I (Jesus) tell you the truth ; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you ; but if I depart I will send him to you"."I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now"."Howbeit when he, the Spirit of Truth is come, he will guide you unto all truth ; for he shall not speak of himself, but whatever he shall hear (from God), that shall he speak (The Quran or Sayings of God): and he will shew you things to come" [175].To appreciate these Ayats of the Quran and verses of the Holy Bible one has to look at Man's past history and the forewarnings given in other Holy Books, and the present condition in which Man is living throughout the world. Only then can one grasp as to what the world may expect in the coming 25 years or so.A. THE SIGNS OF "THE LAST DAYS" OF OUR CIVILISATION !The Holy books of all the leading religions have warned us of these terrible times describing it as "the last days" of the present second civilisation and it foretells the good news of coming of "a new civilisation" or the third civilisation of Man where "Wars" will be forgotten. At last there would be universal peace and goodwill between man and man. A single brotherhood of man would be established irrespective of caste, colour, creed or religion. There would be no distinction between man and man. A real brotherhood. Man would become a huge single family. Something which mankind thirsts for, but has not known for the past 6000 years of its existence. Atleast since Cain killed Abel.B. THE PRESENT WORLD CONDITIONSLet us start with analysing the current world situation. In the "Statesman" Calcutta dated Saturday 12th September 1981 the following news appeared on page 9 under the heading of "Foreign Briefs” :1) “CRIMES IN USA: The crime rate in the USA jumped by 9% last year with murder, rape, robbery or aggravated assult committed every 24 seconds, the FBI reported on Thursday (i.e. 10th September, 1981)".Is America the only country with such confusion, insecurity and moral degradation ? Well here are two news items from page 7 of the Statesman, Calcutta dated 26th June, 1980 :2) "SEX BOATS" : The Council of Rotterdam, the world's largest Port, decided today to start granting licences for "SEX BOATS" on which the city's booming prostitution business may eventually be based".3) "WOMAN STRIPPED AND PARADED" :"NEW DELHI June 25 : A pregnant housewife was stripped and paraded by the police in the crowded Bagpat Bazar of Meerut District in broad daylight on June 18, the Lok Dal Secretary Mr. Narendra Singh MP., alleged here today, reports UNI. Terror stricken people looked on helplessly as the Police dragged Mrs. Swadesh alias Maya Tyagi (30 years) through the bazar to the Police Station where she was allegedly raped by the Police Officials and constables, he added".4) UGANDA MOVES FROM TYRANNY TO CHAOS !Here is an article from page 10 of the Times of India, New Delhi dated 20th May, 1981 under the above heading :"A young mother was travelling by bus along one of the main roads out in the bush. Soon the bus was called to a stop at he Ugandian army road block. Being less obviously ragged and hungry than the other passengers, the young woman was taken to one side."The solders asked for her identity card, and demanded money. She told them she had none. They rummaged inside her clothing but could find nothing. Then they took the baby from her arms and stripped it. Inside soiled nappy they discovered 4000 Ugandian shillings, the equivalent of over £1250/-. Delighted by their discovery, they laid the baby on the roadside and shot it to death".5) These show the moral collapse and violent conditions prevalent throughout not only America or Europe but also in the developing countries of Asia and Africa where the Government officials to maintain law and order are some of the biggest law breakers.6) But there are a number of Governments who are daily indulging in not only murdering their own citizens on the least excuses without any fair trials like Iran and a number of Communist regimes, the Tamils in Sri Lanka and the Muslims in Philippines etc. In South Africa the small White communities of Invaders by force of their superior arms under their apartheid policy refuse to grant the legitimate rights to the larger number of aboriginal population, i.e. Africa's natural population just because they are coloured. A number of them are engaged also in armed commando raids and intervention in neighbouring countries like the Jewish regime in Palestine i.e. Israel and her attacks on her Arab Original Population and its Arab neighbours and occupation of the territories of the Palestinians, Jordanians and Syrians and their destruction of the Nuclear Generation plant of Iraq on 7th June 1981, the Viet Nam occupation of Kampuchea, the U S.S.R. planting a Government of their choice of a non-resident Afghan from Moscow by armed might upon the unwilling people of Afganistan, the Granada episode, and the denial of human rights by several Governments to the less favoured communities amongst their own nationals, etc.7) Even the United Nations have failed to bring about peace amongst Nations. One reads in the Statesman Calcutta dated 2nd September, 1981 :"U.N.H.Q., SEPT 1 : The U.S.A. alone vetoed in the U.N.A. Council last night to kill a Third World resolution that would have strongly condemned South Africa's invasion of Angola, reports A P.".This is but only one of the numerous Vetoes used to suppress the rights of humanity. Such incidents clearly show that powerful Governments like the U.S.A. are supporting the Commando Governments in their mischief upon the neighbouring nations and depriving the nations of their rights to possess their own home and business where they please in their own countries.8) Throughout Europe, Canada and America it has not only been shown on the T.V. what would be the destruction in a Nuclear war but also what would be the great disaster from the after effects of the "Radioactive fall out", which would be far worse that the damage caused by the actual "Blast". Scientists after giving their views have pointed out that every effort has to be made that there must never be a nuclear war. A short Nuclear war can efface Mankind from the face of this planet. Already the number of Nuclear Weapons with the two major powers is quite enough to wipe out every living on the face of the earth more than 1500 times over !9) The Soviet walk out on 23rd November, 1983 from the Geneva Conference with U.S.A. on limiting medium range Nuclear missiles in Europe has caused a very dangerous world situation. Mrs. Indira Gandhi, the ex-Prime Minister of India and the "Chair-person" of the non-alligned countries has declared in New Delhi on 31st March 1984 as follows :"The World situation is more dangerous now than ever before"."When the world situation is deteriorating, the effect of it on the weaker countries is much more serious from every point of view". Mrs. Gandhi said this is an interview with the Austrian Media accompanying the Austrian Chancellor Mr. Fred Sinowatz, who concluded his state visit here yesterday". (The Sunday Statesman, Calcutta dated 1st April 1984).10) U.S. "STAR WAR" PLAN CRITICIZED :In the "Statesman" Calcutta dated 12th April 1984 on page 4 a news item has been given under the above heading : "BONN, April 11—The West German Defence Minister, Mr Manfred Woerner, has voiced fears that the U.S. "Star Wars" plan may create a rift between Europe and USA and may eventually break the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation, reports PTI."In a radio interview, the Minister said the American space armanent plans will further destabilize East-West relations."Mr Woerner, who attended a conference in Turkey last week for NATO Defence Ministers, underlined the need for an agreement between the superpowers to scrap space armament plans which might ignite a global catastrophe".11) WHAT IS STAR-WAR ?Think of it! A few years ago no one seriously thought of outer space as a new line of military defence.Scientific researchers told us of the potential benefits of space exploration to mankind. Orbiting space stations would provide an environment for developing improved vaccines and other biological products of higher quality and purity than can be achieved on earth. Following closely would be space industrialization. Then the construction of space platforms serving as launching and docking facilities for trips into deep space.We have already witnessed the launchings of hundreds of satellites. The placing of human footprints on the moon. Man staying in weightless conditions for long periods in space in orbiting laboratories. Probes have been sent to Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn and Halley's Comet. These accomplishments are awesome. They have changed the out look of us all. Today we rely on satellites for our instantaneous communication, monitoring weather and natural resources, studying the health of crops and water availability, and locating oil and pinpoint their position to within about 50 feet anywhere in the world through a network of satellites.Now it is big news, especially with the publicity surrounding the United States' plan for a "Strategic Defence Initiative", popularly referred to, especially by its critics, as the "Star Wars" system.Early warning spacecrafts hovering in fixed orbit 22,300 miles above the earth detect intercontinental missiles by the heat of their exhausts within seconds of ignition. These givetwice the warning time—from 15 minutes to almost 30 minutes—of an impending attack.Figures vary, but some claims 95 percent of all Soviet and 86 percent of U.S. Satellite launchings are for military purposes !The Soviets' version of the “killer satellite'', once put into orbit, is designed to hunt down its target. When within range, the satellite detonates causing a shrapnel blast like an exploding grenade, destroying its victim. Death rays use laser beams to destroy satellites or other targets.Experts envision the laser beam will be moving at the speed of light ! So there is very little chance of escaping it !From these facts it will be quite clear that the Power, who controls the outer space, will be master and ruler of the world. So future wars with "Laser Beams" will be in space. The winner shall be able to destroy any nation on the face of the earth. These will have a very devastating effect upon our world. No one can hope to escape the calamaties of such "Star Wars" !12) Looking at these conditions of horror, chaos and confusion all around the world one cannot escape feeling that we, the people of this earth, in these last days of the twentieth century, are on a runway train on something which is racing uncontrolled clown a slope at ever increasing speed to its crash !13) World leaders see these critical problems mounting day by day. But they cannot find answers to them. As was said about the United States President Johnson that : "He has consulted the wisest men he knows and cannot figure out what else to do".14) When the wisest of human intellengence has failed to give an answer to solve the universal problems of today and achieve world peace and harmony amongst mankind then what is one to do ?From these it will be clear that we are now in a similar conditions of moral degradation and scientific achievements with two camps of superpowers as was the case with predeluge people.Because the the predeluge people refused to obey God and His orders they were destroyed. Their scientific equipments could not save them ! So also the Nuclear Umbrella and Nuclear Prewarning systems, the satellite interception and destruction devices will not be able to save us. Only those who believed comprising of Noah and his family i.e. his wife, his three believing sons and their three wives were saved. So also those who believe in God and His Guidance will have a chance to save themselves on this occasion also.C. ACCORDING TO THE HOLY BIBLEFourteen conditions which mark the last days of our present Civilisation are given here from the New Testament. From these it will again be clear that we have today reached all these conditions :1) "Nation shall rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom........" (St. Matthew 24 : 7).2) "There shall be famines...........in diverse places" (St. Matthew 24 : 7).3) "There shall be........pestilences…….in diverse places" (St. Matthew 24 : 7).4) "There shall be......earthquakes, in diverse places" (St. Matthew 24 : 7).5) "Iniquity shall abound" (St. Matthew 24 : 12).6) "Disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy" (2 Timothy 3 : 2).7) "Lovers of their own-selves, covetous" (2 Timothy 3 : 2).8) "Lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God" (2 Timothy 3 : 4).9) "Having a form of Godliness but denying the power thereof" (2 Timothy 3 : 5).10) "Deceiving and being deceived" (2 Timothy 3 : 13).11) Man's vast knowledge will prove useless (2 Timothy 3 : 7).12) Peace—A sign of coming Destruction (1 Thessalonians 5 : 3).13) "Them which destroy the earth" as a habitat for mankind (Revelation 11 : 18).14) "In the last days perilous times shall come" (2 Timothy 3 : 1).D. ACCORDING TO HINDU SCRIPTURESAnother set of 14 signs have been given in the 3500 years old Hindu Book Pages 5 & 6 of "Kalki Puran" :1) The standard of the people will be so low that honesty and fair dealings will hardly exist. Deceipt, bribery and corruption will be prevalent.2) Trades in liquids from foreign lands will be not only in huge quantities but also will be sought for.3) Children will not only cause difficulties but even bring disgrace upon thir parents.4) Students and disciples will speak, behave and conduct themselves against their teachers and guides. Their immature ideologies will be the source of revolt and spread of materialism.5) The working class will insist upon their rights but would not be ready to fulfil their duties and obligations.6) The masses will not care to study nor pay heed to the teachings of the religious scriptures. They would rather enjoy books on illicit love, thrills and violence which would make them evil.7) The rich will be honoured even when they are in the wrong. Their wealth will be used to control Governments for their selfish gains.8) Ladies from respectable families, whose shadows were even unseen before would freely mix with strangers. Women will have less fidelity towards their husbands. LOVE marriages will be in vogue. It will replace the system of marriage by the choice of parents for the good qualities to be found, which makes marriages a life long success. They will pride thamselves upon their broadmindedness in freedom of sex to such an extent that it will pose a threat to the institution of marriage. The effect would be divorces and the breaking up of the happiness in many homes. These would result in disregard for welfare of children due to broken-up families thus making youth rebellious.9) Food will grow less. Clouds will not give rains when required. Heavy rains would cause floods destroying standing crops. Several famines would be caused. Artificial means of agriculture will have to be adapted to try and cause a green revolution to meet the drastic situation of famines.10) Taxes will be exorbitant.11) The pious and good people would prefer to stay away from the gaiety of society. As such their influence on the masses will become ineffective.12) These times will be so troublesome that joy and contentment will be gone from the faces of mankind, who will be blindly searching for guidance and deliverance.13) Any body walking with a staff in his hand or wearing safron clothes or the robe of a priest and hanging rosaries and beads around their necks, would be regarded as sages. Those who are without gainful employment would see in this a good opportunity of making a paying livelihood. So they would become priests and spiritual guides or "gurus" but without any desire for the divine adoration but rather sexual pleasures. As such religious influence and books will become less effective.14) The uneducated masses will have the right of vote on the basis of adult franchise. Their chosen leaders, with a view to influence the masses, will follow such immature policies as would cause harm and confusion in their countries. Thereby reducing "democracy" into "demon-crazy".E. HOW TO PROVE THAT IT RELATES TO OUR TIME ?Similar conditions as the above have been described as the last days of the present civilisation by many other religions including Buddhist Tibetan, Chinese in addition to the Holy Bible, the Hindu Scriptures and Islam.How can we be sure that we are now living in that period of time which have been universally described in the numerous religions as "the last days" of our present civilisation ? Just one of these events by itself is not a proof. All of them must come together at a time like the multifarious lines that form a fingerprint.Does not the present world conditions clearly establish that we are definitely living according to all the signs of the last days of our present civilisation ? Are we not bringing this disaster by our own deeds upon ourselves ? Are we not in exactly the same conditions of scientific advancement as the predeluge people ? Do we not deserve the same destruction as the first civilisation ?Now what does various sources inform as going to take place in the near future !F. SOME FORETELLINGS ON NUCLEAR WARSShah Neamatullah (died 825 AH/1431 AD buried at Mahan near Kirman in Persia) has prosphesied about the three coming Nuclear wars as follows :Couplet 62 : "As described before the disasters through which India has passed.The same type of disasters will set in for the Western Bloc of countries resulting in three wars".Couplet 64 : “The (Scientists of) defeated "Geam" (which is 'G' in the Persian language. The country which was defeated in the last two world wars and whose name starts with 'G' is Germany) would be forced by the conquering countries (like Russia, America, Britain etc.) to prepare such arms which would burst like erupting volcanoes causing fiery hells stef.'And these would be used without any mercy or consideration by 'Ra' (or 'R' the first letter of Russia) in this war upon heavily populated areas".Couplet 63 : "Out of the (two allied countries whose names commence with) 'Alifs' about whom I have written earlier. (These two Alifs or 'A' in Persian script stand for the first letter of Anglistan or England and America), one Alif (i e. Anglistan) will become knocked out like a felled horse in this war."Whilst the other Alif which is to the West (of the first Alif i.e. Anglistan) will simultaneously be attacked by 'Ra' (i.e. Russia) in the said war".Couplet 65 : "(The two countries whose names commence with ) Alif will be eliminated in such a devastating form."That no trace will be left of them save and except their names in the pages of history".Couplet 66 : "This ( kind of annihilation of nations ) would be the punishment of the Almighty Invisible (God) upon the sinful Western Civilisation."Never again will they be able to claim the seat of priestly power to influence this world".Couplet 67 : "The disbelievers in God (i. e. Communists or Materialist) will conquer the world ( after destroying the Western Civilisation in the first atomic war)."But in the second (Nuclear disaster) they will be destroyed completely and condemmed to hell".Couplet 69 : "If you want success and continuity ( of your nations ), ( I beg of you ) in the name of Allah, obey his orders."Live according to his last set of Commandments ( which is in any case going to be established after The Battle of Armageddon )".G. THE HOLY BIBLE WARNS OF THREE MASS-SCALE DEATHS !"And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of (1) the mouth of the dragon, (2) out of the mouth of the beast and (3) out of the mouth of the false prophet."For they are the spirits ( or Souls ) of the devils working miracles which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty."Behold, I come as a thief........"And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon" [176].The only living thing that can come out of the mouth of a person is his soul. Whenever that happens the body naturally dies. From the above it would be obvious that there will be three major catastrophes causing the annihilation of three major groups of people collected from all over the earth comprising of numerous different nations or kingdoms. Now let us try to find out what are these three disasters ? And how it will effect us ?H. THE DESTRUCTION OF THE DRAGON !The first of these concerns a “dragon". The spirit coming out of the mouth in the from of a frog indicates the destruction of the dragon. This power will gather the kings of the earth to their destiny. So this amalgamation will comprise of numerous powerful countries.The dragon stands for "The Great Babylon" as would be clear from a subsequent verse — "And great Babylon came into rememberance before God, give unto her the cup wine of the fierceness of His wrath" [177].This is the reference to the first "Nuclear Holocaust" which is meant to destroy Babylonia from the face of the earth.Today there is no place known as "Babylon". Babylon and its civilisation was effaced several thousands of years ago !Now arises the question as to who are represented in modern times by this "Babylon" according to Biblical Scholars?President Rutherford of the Watch Tower Bible Society made the following declaration to 15,000 Bible students in Toronto as far back as Sunday 24th July 1927 :".....With great pomp and glory that unholy system rides upon the backs of peoples. Without the support of the common people that wicked system called Christendom could not survive. When peoples withdraw their support therefrom Organised Christianity which is a part of Babylon or the Devil's organisation will fall like a great millstone into the sea."The doom of organised Christianity or Babylon is sealed !"The Greater Babylonia, according to these Bible Students and the Watch Tower Bible Society, comprises the Christian Nations of the world. It includes America, the U.K., and Europe. The Holy Bible supports by the following warnings :"And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power ; and the earth was lightened with his glory"."And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying : Babylon The Great (i.e. all countries following the teachings of King Nimrod of Babylon which comprises of Trinity in Unity, the only begotten son of God, the sin bearer who sacrificed his earthly life to become the saviour of his baptised uncircumcised followers, the sign of the Cross, observance of Sun god's day as sabbath Sunday, eating of sacramental food and wine as the body and blood of the sinless son of god, eating of swine flesh as the flesh of Prophet Abraham the destroyer of Nimrod or Baal or Tammuz. These brought the curse of God upon the united Mankind at the Tower of Babel. This religion of Babylon was adapted at the Nicaean Council in 325 A.D. and is being practiced in its original form with all its details till this day by Christianity and is totally different from what Jesus had taught) is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and cage of every unclean and hateful bird"."For all nations (who follow the religion of Babylon) have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies (For the past century the rich nations of the world are North America, the U.K., and Europe so it is again a reference to the same group of Christian nations)”."And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, came out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues (This is the Biblical warning to people to leave North America, the U.K. and Europe which seem to be destined to be destroyed)”."For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities"."Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works, in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double" [178]."How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow (This is a reference to the false sense of security based on their dependence upon their Nuclear might, the Nuclear star war detection, interception and destruction umbrella built by the advanced European groups of Nations including North America and the USSR)."Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning and famine, and she shall be utterly burned with fire”.This is a very clear Biblical warning of Nuclear Holocaust which will have the following features :1) This war will last for only ONE DAY.2) It will burn and destroy utterly Great Babylonia or the Christian Countries of North America, the U.K., and Europe. The Bible is referring to it by the words ". ....she shall be utterly burned with fire".3) Not only those areas destroyed by the Nuclear blast but also all those nearby countries which will be effected by the radioactive fall-out. Those parts of the earth would became barren wastes due to the after effects. The after effects will be much more terrible than being destroyed in the flash of a second when the blast takes place. This is clearly indicated by the words "mourning and famine" mentioned in the Bible. Perhaps the very structure of the countries involved will be so altered by the sinking of large areas and the rising of new lands from the sea-bed that they may not even be regarded by their earlier names.4) All this will happen very suddenly without any prior warning in the course of one day when the people of the earth would be least expecting the disaster "for strong is the Lord God, Who judgeth her" [178].This warning is also to be found in the old Jewish religious books :"Gather yourselves together yea, gather together, O shameless Nation."Before the decree bring forth the day when one passeth as the chalf (this is again the reference to the warning that in the course of a day they will be burnt into ashes), before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord's anger come upon you."Seek ye the Lord, all ye humble of earth, that have executed His Ordinance ; seek humility.
